mapper.select: SELECT id, employee_id AS employeeId, scheme_id AS schemeId, base_salary AS baseSalary, allowance_base_json AS allowanceBaseJson, ss_base AS ssBase, hf_base AS hfBase, performance_base AS performanceBase, probation_ratio AS probationRatio, effective_date AS effectiveDate, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM employee_salary_profile WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_salary_profile (employee_id, scheme_id, base_salary, allowance_base_json, ss_base, hf_base, performance_base, probation_ratio, effective_date) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{schemeId}, #{baseSalary}, #{allowanceBaseJson}, #{ssBase}, #{hfBase}, #{performanceBase}, #{probationRatio}, #{effectiveDate})
